description: Treesitter parser installer and query distribution for Neovim 0.12+. Vinela enables core FileType highlighting; install and update parsers explicitly with :TSInstall and :TSUpdate.
author: nvim-treesitter
tagline: Parser management and core syntax highlighting for Neovim 0.12+

options.label: Enable Highlighting
options.description: Enable treesitter-based syntax highlighting via vim.treesitter.start on FileType. Missing or incompatible parsers are skipped without error. Neovim 0.12 provides core incremental selection mappings (:help treesitter-incremental-selection).

options.label: Disable Highlighting For
options.description: Parser language names (after vim.treesitter.language.get_lang resolution) to skip for treesitter highlighting.

functions.name: install_parser
functions.label: Install Parser
functions.description: Install a treesitter parser for a specific language
functions.whatItDoes: Runs :TSInstall asynchronously to download and install a Treesitter parser for the given language. Already-installed parsers are a no-op. Check :TSLog or :checkhealth nvim-treesitter for failures.

params.name: language
params.description: Language name to install parser for (e.g., 'lua', 'python')

functions.name: update_parsers
functions.label: Update All Parsers
functions.whatItDoes: Runs :TSUpdate asynchronously to refresh installed Treesitter parsers and queries to the current main-branch revisions. Run after updating nvim-treesitter, then restart or reopen affected buffers.

exCommands.name: TSInstall
exCommands.description: Asynchronously install one or more Treesitter parsers by language name. Already-installed parsers are a no-op.

exCommands.name: TSUpdate
exCommands.description: Asynchronously update installed Treesitter parsers and queries. Specify languages to update specific parsers, or omit to update all installed parsers. Run after updating nvim-treesitter.

exCommands.name: TSUninstall
exCommands.description: Delete one or more Treesitter parsers by language name.

exCommands.name: TSLog
exCommands.description: Open the nvim-treesitter log buffer for install/update diagnostics.

render.template:
local config = {{config}}
if config.highlight and config.highlight.enable then
  local highlight_disable = {}
  for _, lang in ipairs(config.highlight.disable or {}) do
    highlight_disable[lang] = true
  end
  local augroup = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup('VinelaNvimTreesitterHighlight', { clear = true })
  vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('FileType', {
    group = augroup,
    pattern = '*',
    callback = function(args)
      local lang_ok, lang = pcall(vim.treesitter.language.get_lang, vim.bo[args.buf].filetype)
      if not lang_ok or not lang or highlight_disable[lang] then
        return
      end
      pcall(vim.treesitter.start, args.buf, lang)
    end,
  })
end
